title: SearchAPI release event — deploy hash jkl012
description: Deployment event recorded for SearchAPI service. Release hash: jkl012. Deployment completed at 16:00 UTC. This is the root deployment event for the jkl012 release of SearchAPI. Child tickets referencing release_hash jkl012 should be grouped under this event for triage.

title: SearchAPI returning stale results after jkl012 deploy
description: Since the jkl012 deployment of SearchAPI at 16:00 UTC, search queries are returning stale cached results. The index refresh mechanism appears to have broken. Multiple product teams are reporting degraded search quality. This regression is tied to release_hash jkl012.

title: SearchAPI 503 errors — jkl012 release regression
description: SearchAPI is returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable on all query endpoints since the jkl012 release at 16:00 UTC. Real-time search is completely non-functional. SRE has confirmed the 503s started immediately after the jkl012 deployment completed. Candidate for rollback of release_hash jkl012.

title: SearchAPI indexing issue — different deployment mno345
description: An indexing configuration issue discovered in the SearchAPI deployment with release_hash mno345, which was deployed two weeks ago. This is a separate deployment from the current jkl012 release. The mno345 issue involves index mapping changes that conflict with a schema update. Not related to jkl012.

title: SearchAPI index rebuild request — maintenance
description: Routine search index rebuild request for the SearchAPI service. The full-text index requires a monthly rebuild to maintain performance. No relation to any specific deployment event or release hash. This is scheduled maintenance per the SRE calendar.
